description: Unit tests for the NonEmptyValueValidator class ensuring it correctly validates header values, including null checks, immutability, and acceptance of non-empty strings.

classes.name: NonEmptyValueValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the NonEmptyValueValidator ensuring it behaves correctly under various input conditions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the validator instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that NonEmptyValueValidator instances are immutable.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullDefinition
methods.description: Ensures that accepting a null header definition throws a NullPointerException with an appropriate message.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullValue
methods.description: Checks that passing null as the value throws DittoHeaderInvalidException with a specified message.

methods.name: acceptValidCharSequence
methods.description: Tests that a proper non-empty string is accepted without exceptions.

methods.name: doesNotValidateAsValueIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks that an empty string leads to a DittoHeaderInvalidException indicating it must not be empty.
